notes.title: 1.22.2 Update!
notes.notes:
Our games have always been based on realism
At the same time, it is necessary to make adjustments about the player experience.
In this update, we installed a realistic physiological system to make the game more realistic.
The following is the update.

Fatigue system renewal
Players will be tired from running too much.
After the fatigue effect is triggered, the player's recovery speed will slow down and his heart rate and blood oxygen will also be affected.

Blood oxygen mechanism addition
If the blood oxygen is too low in the game, it will lead to a decrease in the recovery health.
There are many mechanisms that affect blood oxygen, including but not limited to running and eating high-energy foods.

Dynamic display of secondary physiological values
Now the value of the secondary biological sign of the player's medical panel will be displayed normally.
Players can use these values to judge whether your character is normal or not.

Cause of death shows
After the player dies in the game, you don't need to find someone else to do an autopsy for you!
After the player dies, your cause of death will be displayed in the death panel.
Of course, he will only show the specific cause of death and will not tell you what caused the death.

The above is the specific content of this update.
Our update direction during this period is mainly based on simulation.
All kinds of behaviors of players in the game may influence the characters manipulated in the game.
To give players a more immersive and realistic experience.

notes.title: The official version of 1.0 is here!
notes.notes:
After two months of alpha and beta testing, the official version of 1.0 arrived as scheduled.
Compared with the beta version, there are very few bugs in the official version, and some optimization adjustments have been made to greatly improve the player's game experience.
The only pity is that some functions have not been installed because of time, and these functions will come one by one with the version update.
Next is the update of 1.0.

Deke nature reserve Extend
Deke Nature Reserve Ushered in its first expansion. A new building [logging yard transfer station] has been added to this expansion
And the adjustment of the surrounding environment.
And monsters that have not been installed before have also joined Deke nature reserve.

Deke nature reserve Story update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/1142c18eeab0ff972f49b105edb2f3b6999cdd74.png
The regional story of Deke nature reserve has been added, and players can find the story task items in the game to understand the story behind Deke nature reserve.

Production system installation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/c0a5b09ba494bc31b69f57a734ed82a4683edcf4.png
Are you still worried that there is no warm bonfire in the wild? Don't worry now!
The production system has been installed, and players can find production materials on the map to make corresponding items.
Although there are very few things that can be made at present, it is definitely a good start, and we will continue to improve it in future updates.

Navigation system update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/debdcc535a46621a96355895bf94be27b8877cae.png
We improved the existing navigation system to make it more like real navigation software.
And the UI has also been renovated.
In order to facilitate players to meet, we allow players to see each other on the navigation system.

Mental state system installation
The mental state system has been installed, and the player's reason will decline if he stays in the dark for a long time or touches monsters.
When the player's mental state drops to collapse, it will have negative effects, such as blurred vision and easier to be targeted.
So how do you restore your mental state? You may need the company of many people or a warm bonfire to comfort your broken heart.

The above is the main update content of this 1.0
Let's not talk about the rest of the scattered content and bug fixes.
We have been trying to update and maintain our games.
Thank you for your continuous support.

notes.title: 0.53 beat patch
notes.notes:
This update solves an important problem and makes some adjustments.

Many players reported that they could not enter the game. After our investigation, we locked the problem and solved it!
Now all players can enter the game normally.

There are also some bugs, such as not playing UI animation when treating massive hemorrhage, and being unable to use mobile phones, which have been fixed.

Adjusted the player's power consumption and food consumption.

We are sorry to have caused such a big problem to the players and prevented them from playing the game normally.
We are deeply sorry for this.
